# BRK-B — Berkshire Hathaway (IDEATION 2026-11-13)

**Signal / why now:** #12 GLOBAL MOMENTUM, $589.83, **0.0% off its 52-week high** (mom12 +5.9%, mom6 +21.9%, mom1 +12.1%, CAGR 12.4%, vol 14.6%, corr −0.03, ADV $2.64bn). The row is the last un-carded name on the GLOBAL screen; this card settles it rather than re-litigating it next session.

**Regime: NEUTRAL.** No desk tilt covers a US insurance/rail/utility conglomerate; CAUTIOUS risk appetite with DXY within 0.3% of its high is a backdrop, not a named stance.

**Archetype:** `holdco_discount_narrowing` (0.33/+28/−18, 3y) is the honest key, and it fails check 1 outright: 0.33×28 − 0.67×18 = **−2.8%/3y**. `momentum_continuation` (0.50/+30/−22, 0.75y) gives **+4.0%/0.75y (~5.3%/yr)**, under the ~8.1% hurdle.

**Fast-disqualify:**
- EV negative at the holdco prior; sub-hurdle at momentum.
- No valuation anchor: no dossier, no house coverage, no estimate set in house data; the stock pays no dividend and sits at its high, so the +30% up-leg is multiple expansion with nothing to anchor it — the method card's auto-kill.
- Primary sources (10-K/10-Q) reachable ✓.

DISCARD. Re-test only on a dossier with an estimate set and a book-value/float anchor, or a genuine drawdown that puts the discount on the table.

**3 questions if re-carded:** What is the look-through value of the equity book versus the operating businesses? Is the cash pile earning enough at a falling front end to defend the multiple? What discount would a break-up or dividend initiation actually close?
